scenario.objective: Minimize unmet highest, time-sensitive and routine requests in order, then minimize travel seconds.
scenario.simulated: Patients, demand, acuity, slots, capabilities, times and travel are invented for this fixture. Location data is separate. This does not describe any facility's actual services.
